Subject: SUP-08 / SI-CM-0008 — Supporting evidence requested

Hello,

Thank you for your packet for part SI-CM-0008. Please send supporting documents or records for the following items:

1. 1.internal_audit — internal audit program: procedure and most recent audit records.
2. 1.capa — documented corrective-action (CAPA) process and sample records.
3. 1.calibration — gauge calibration program covering production gauges, with calibration records.
4. 2.pfmea — current process failure-mode analysis (PFMEA) for this part.
5. 2.control_plan — control plan covering rail spacing, mounting fastener torque and manifold alignment.
6. 2.spc — evidence SPC is in use now on these CTQs (charts and reaction plan).
7. 3.inspection_method — inspection methods and equipment used for the CTQ tolerances.
8. 4.method_criteria — test methods and acceptance criteria documents for the required tests.
9. 4.sample_size — the statistical sample-size rationale or cited standard for the required tests.
10. 5.lot_trace — lot or serial traceability to raw material, with an example trace record.
11. 5.nc_segregation — nonconforming material identification and segregation procedure and records.
12. 8.flowdown — evidence that requirements are flowed down to the sub-tier supplier.
13. 9.second_source — qualification record for the alternate source (Horizon Labs).

Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts
